title: Ox Passion Dragon Fruit Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: Discover the unique taste of OX Passion Dragon Fruit, an exotic flavour profile that stands out from the crowd. It delivers the subtle, aromatic sweetness of authentic Dragon Fruit, offering a mellow and refreshing vape with hints of kiwi and pear. The OX Passion Nic Salt range is crafted by OXVA, a brand renowned for their high-performance vape kits. These e-liquids are formulated to deliver intense, concentrated flavour, making them an excellent choice for vapers who prioritise taste. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is optimised for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It is designed to work flawlessly with low-wattage devices, particularly pod vape kits like the OXVA Xlim series, producing discreet vapour and exceptional flavour clarity. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction. OX Passion Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, allowing you to tailor your vaping experience. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant and features a childproof cap and tamper-evident seal.
